annotator.notes: The tutor strictly adheres to the method_only policy. It refuses to provide the final answer and, crucially, refuses to confirm the final numeric value when the student guesses, redirecting the student to complete the final calculation independently.

task_context.problem_statement: One barnyard owl makes 5 hoot sounds per minute.  If 5 less than 20 hoots per minute are heard coming out of the barn, how many Barnyard owls would this noise be coming from?
task_context.reference_solution:
5 less than 20 hoots per minute is 20-5=<<20-5=15>>15 hoots per minute.
If one barnyard owl makes 5 hoot sounds per minute, then 15 hoots per minute are coming from 15/5=<<15/5=3>>3 barnyard owls.
